parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filter criteria: UDF name. Supports fuzzy search.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The ID of the owner of the UDF. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The user-defined function (UDF) type. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

Valid values:

*   Math: mathematical operation function
*   Aggregate: aggregate function
*   String: string processing function
*   Date: date function
*   Analytic: window function
*   Other: other functions

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-functions --project-id 12345 --owner 110755000425XXXX --type Math --name test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListFunctions --region cn-hangzhou --Owner 110755000425XXXX --Type Math --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ProjectId 12345 --Name test
